value.answer: This is often a stomach bug, usually viral, and it tends to settle within a few days. Keep offering small, frequent sips of oral rehydration solution (or breast milk/formula) - plain water alone isn't advised. Still drinking and wet diapers are good signs.
value.triage: Call 811 any time if no pee in 6 hours, no tears, dry mouth, can't keep fluids down, blood in the stool, or it drags on past a few days. Go to the ER or call 911 now if very sleepy or hard to wake, limp, green or bloody vomit, or severe belly pain.
